snippet.title: Last Orbit Repairs - Robot Repair Sim in Orbit | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Repair broken robots in a small workshop orbiting a dead Earth.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5615000/Last_Orbit_Repairs/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer

Last Orbit Repairs is a calm first-person robot repair sim focused on careful, hands-on work.
Unbolt covers, clean dust layer by layer, test parts on machines, and solder broken connections.
Read the memory cards inside the robots to uncover quiet stories from the people of nearby stations.
A small helper robot works beside you in the shop. Targeting a 2027 release on Steam.

Made solo at Lyn Studio. All footage is real in-game capture.

#LastOrbitRepairs #IndieGame #RobotRepair #SimulationGame #SciFiGames #SoloDev #Steam
